_key.description: The 'SEMpl_'-prefixed complex key and the Ensembl protein ID, joined by an underscore.

_from.description: Document handle of the transcription factor complex.

_to.description: Document handle of one protein subunit of that complex.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction: the complex contains this protein.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction: the protein belongs to this complex.

source.description: The dataset this edge was loaded from.

source_url.description: Link to the IGVF model file this edge was derived from.
